purpose: Complete 16-scenario Clover Studio user-visible regression & quality catalogue across all 14 product categories plus exact big-math and UI continuity.

scenarios.task: Explain a technical concept concisely and state a verifiable factual constant.
expected: Non-empty, coherent explanation returned through /api/chat/stream.
Contains accurate domain facts and completes SSE stream cleanly.

scenarios.task: Introduce named values in Turn 1, then ask a pronoun/reference follow-up in Turn 2.
expected: Turn 2 retains exact Turn 1 context and computes the derived answer.
No cross-session leakage.

scenarios.task: Ask Clover to remember a specific preference in Session A, then recall it in Session B.
expected: Preference persisted to isolated Studio memory store.
Accurately recalled in a brand-new session without unrelated leakage.

scenarios.task: Read a deterministic local research URL and synthesize its cited figures.
expected: fetch_url executes against the user-supplied URL.
Final answer cites the exact retrieved figures without fabrication.

scenarios.task: Exercise Studio browser/page inspection and verify actual page state.
expected: Browser/page tool or Playwright UI interaction observes real DOM state.

scenarios.task: Read a disposable text file, update a requested line, and leave sibling files untouched.
expected: Target file updated with exact requested content.
Sibling bystander file SHA-256 remains 100% unchanged.

scenarios.task: Use Python to compute exact statistics over a dataset and verify independently.
expected: run_python executes and prints exact result.
Answer matches independent Python evaluator calculation.

scenarios.task: Aggregate regional revenue from regional_sales.csv and generate a bar chart PNG.
expected: analyze_table / chart_table computes exact regional totals (North=4250.5, West=5620.0).
Generated chart PNG exists on disk, decodes cleanly, and has non-trivial visual entropy.

scenarios.task: Compute exact 20 hexadecimal digits of Pi at offset 1,000,000 via x-cruncher.
expected: calculate / x-cruncher tool executes native C11 engine.
Returns exact 6c65e52cb459350050e4 verified independently.

scenarios.task: Upload a known visual test image and ask what colors/objects appear.
expected: Multimodal model processes actual attached image.
Response accurately describes the visual subject.

scenarios.task: Request a detailed generative scene image and verify backend capability & PNG output.
expected: If generative backend is installed/configured: valid generative PNG returned with provenance.
If generative backend is absent: explicit backend_capability error (never a silent procedural sunset).

scenarios.task: Edit a supplied reference image while preserving unrequested elements.
expected: Gateway routes to /images/edits or sd-cli img2img when available, or reports honest capability gap.

scenarios.task: Send a real spoken 16 kHz WAV voice question and verify spoken-content comprehension.
expected: Audio attachment accepted and decoded by Omni audio encoder.
Reply answers the spoken question accurately.

scenarios.task: Attach a short multi-color/scene MP4 video and ask about its visual content.
expected: Video frames extracted/processed without error.
Reply accurately describes the scene colors/events.

scenarios.task: Fix a deliberate bug in a disposable Python module and verify unit tests pass.
expected: Code change applied in disposable workspace.
Independent execution of workspace unit test exits 0.

scenarios.task: Attempt a gated tool with permission=Ask, deny it first, then approve once.
expected: Permission prompt emitted over SSE / UI.
Denying blocks execution; approving once executes cleanly.

scenarios.task: Operate real Studio UI in Chromium, reload mid-session, and verify zero JS errors & continuity.
expected: Zero uncaught pageerror or CSP errors.
Conversation persists across browser reload.
